title: Marginal performance gains could increase agency revenue by 46%
summary:
Estate agencies could increase fee income by 46.4% from the same number of valuations by improving four key performance metrics by 10% each, according to analysis from property brokerage Moveli. The firm has launched an online calculator that allows agencies to model potential earnings based on conversion rates and fee structures.

title: Independent firms claim top awards at ESTAS 2026
summary:
Independent property firms have secured all four top Grand Prix Gold awards at The ESTAS 2026, according to results announced following the ceremony at London's Grosvenor House Hotel. The awards, determined entirely by verified customer reviews, saw smaller locally-run businesses take top honours across estate agency, lettings, conveyancing and mortgage broking categories.

title: Five characterful homes across England listed for sale
summary:
Five residential properties featuring distinctive interior design schemes have been listed for sale across England, with asking prices ranging from £750,000 to £900,000. The listings span locations from London to Dorset, including period cottages and eco-renovated buildings.

title: Atelier provides £46.1m for Hammersmith office conversion
summary:
Development finance lender Atelier has provided a £46.1m loan to Sheen Lane Developments for the acquisition and conversion of Griffin House, a redundant office building in Hammersmith, west London. The 18-month facility will support the permitted development conversion of the property into studio apartments.

title: Northern England outpaces South in property price growth
summary:
Regional house price performance has diverged significantly, with northern regions demonstrating stronger growth whilst southern markets struggle with affordability constraints. Data since 2022 shows the Midlands and North recording consistent growth, whilst southern and eastern regions face ongoing price falls and extended sales periods.

title: New-build output falls for three consecutive months
summary:
Government plans to deliver 1.5 million new homes by 2029 face mounting challenges as official data shows a consecutive decline in new-build construction output. Office for National Statistics figures reveal that private sector residential new-build completions in Britain fell from 3,309 units in May to 3,103 in August, representing a 6.2% decline over the three-month period.

title: Estate agents use AI for listings but neglect sales tools
summary:
Two-thirds of estate agents use artificial intelligence tools to write property descriptions, but adoption for sales-critical functions remains minimal, according to new research. A survey of 250 estate and letting agents found that 85% limit AI use to four tasks or fewer, with only 4% applying it to sales progression.

title: Survey reveals landlord confidence drops amid tax concerns
summary:
Only 28% of private landlords are confident that letting property will remain financially viable over the next five years, according to new research from LegalforLandlords. The survey found that 40% of landlords plan to raise rents if they face higher taxes in this month's Budget.

title: Existing homeowner enquiries for new builds rise 23%
summary:
Enquiries from existing homeowners for new-build properties have increased 23% in the first half of 2026 compared to the previous six months. The North East recorded the largest increase at 43%, while London was the only region to decline.

title: Wirral landlord fined £7,400 for eight-year gas safety breach
summary:
A Wirral landlord has been fined £7,400 after failing to conduct mandatory annual gas safety checks at a rental property for eight years. Adam Evans pleaded guilty to breaching gas safety regulations at a property occupied by a tenant and her five children.
